attributes.description: Summit Securities Ltd is an RBI-registered, non-deposit-taking Middle Layer NBFC focused principally on long-term holding and investment in securities. The consolidated group comprises Summit and its wholly owned investment subsidiary Instant Holdings Ltd, making consolidated accounts the appropriate basis for assessing its complete investment portfolio and income. [1]
